message.reasoning_content: We need to determine the crime based on facts: selling pirated CDs for profit. Under Chinese criminal law, this is "侵犯著作权罪" (Copyright infringement) or "非法出版、复制、发行侵犯著作权的作品罪". The specific article is Article 217 of Criminal Law (now Article 218 after amendment). The crime is "侵犯著作权罪". So answer format: [罪名]侵犯著作权罪<eoa>.
